workflow: A clone-like operation invokes an overridable construction hook for an object subtype.
The hook returns an ordinary object whose type and storage do not satisfy the expected subtype layout.
The operation accepts the result without validating its type and reinterprets it as the expected structured object.
A later metadata update accesses fields at offsets belonging to the expected layout, causing an invalid memory access instead of a recoverable type error.
summary: Unchecked construction result causes incompatible-layout metadata access
